correct_transcript_route: Giving correct text removes the speech recognizer’s transcript mistakes. Because this route still drops from 4/4 to 2/4, the answer component can be responsible and the regression cannot all be blamed on ASR. The real-ASR route asks about the actual combined pipeline, with the same recognized text for all candidates; its score also drops, from 3/4 to 2/4.
photo_score_route: The photo successes rise by 7 out of 28 and 22 out of 56, but both chat routes fail their separate at-least-base thresholds. Delivery of a correction also requires normal ending and a strictly improved previously agreed composite score. A gain in only photo tasks cannot make all these conditions true.
prose_result_scope: The section cites the longer candidate and incomplete generations from an earlier full experiment; I did not reproduce those results. The base is retained under the decision rule even though it has errors, then the frozen chosen configuration receives a new final test.
